description: This file defines the ProjectViewResourceList class, a subclass of SugarView, responsible for rendering a resource list view for project management within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes HTML and JavaScript for displaying a Gantt chart and associated UI components.

classes.name: ProjectViewResourceList
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying the project resource list, including a Gantt chart and UI overlays.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to render the resource list view with a Gantt chart for project management.
